description: Best practices for building accessible, secure, and user-friendly web forms. Use this guide when creating or modifying forms, inputs, and submission flows.

Actionable coding guidelines for building accessible web applications, covering semantic HTML, focus management, forms, media, and testing. Use this skill when auditing or implementing accessibility features, keyboard navigation, or ARIA.

Synchronize programmatic accessibility states (like aria-invalid) with the visual :user-invalid state to ensure screen reader users receive error feedback only after interaction, mirroring the visual experience.

Action-oriented guidelines for modern HTML architecture, semantics, native interactive APIs (Dialog, Popover, Details), focus management, and resource prioritization. Use this guide when structuring web documents, implementing native overlays, or optimizing resource loading order.
Expose client-side functionality as tools to AI agents by annotating standard HTML forms with WebMCP attributes.
